metrics.definition: Among CTA Immune-positive spots, quantify the fraction or mass assigned by baseline to non-immune compartments.
metrics.phase_to_compute: Phase 4/5 after formal baseline output audit
metrics.allowed_claim: Baseline-vs-endpoint contradiction can be quantified after baseline outputs exist.
metrics.disallowed_claim: Do not claim baseline creates false niche calls in Phase 3.

metrics.definition: Compare immune-related assignment score in CTA Immune-positive spots versus CTA Immune-negative spots.
metrics.phase_to_compute: Phase 4/5 after formal baseline output audit
metrics.allowed_claim: Endpoint enrichment metric is predefined before mapping comparison.
metrics.disallowed_claim: Do not report enrichment values in Phase 3.

metrics.definition: Use mapping-derived immune assignment score to classify CTA Immune-positive versus CTA Immune-negative spots.
metrics.phase_to_compute: Phase 4/5 after formal baseline output audit
metrics.allowed_claim: Classification metric is predefined before formal comparison.
metrics.disallowed_claim: Do not report AUROC/AUPRC in Phase 3.

metrics.definition: Among baseline contradicted CTA Immune-positive spots, quantify the fraction converted by SVTuner to reference-unrepresented or withheld.
metrics.allowed_claim: Prevention metric is defined as a future SVTuner evaluation endpoint.
metrics.disallowed_claim: Do not claim prevention before SVTuner outputs and audit exist.
